feature: Native ABI readiness, validation and callbacks
gap: ABI checks do not establish Papyrus VM binding or downstream consumer compatibility.
Generated assets exercise parsing and sampled transforms; third-party rigs and visual retargeting need asset-specific review.

feature: AF and BA2 import; solo playback
gap: The runtime uses one installed vanilla human AF. Creature rigs and the wider AF corpus need separate acceptance.

feature: Shared clock, frame queue and playback speed
gap: Multi-actor visual sync and pause/minimize cadence need in-game multi-actor observations.
Setter acceptance does not prove furniture transforms, collision, culling or visible root pinning.

feature: Pose composition, masks and additive math
gap: Visible seams, transitions, live rig rebinding and actor 3D unload/reload need game acceptance.

feature: Scene registry, templates, tracks and import diagnostics
gap: Offline fixtures stub clip availability and avoid engine form resolution. Missing-mod/race/keyword resolution needs game acceptance.
Baseline graph navigation does not cover every authored graph, interruption or per-role policy.

feature: Timed marks, events and scene completion
gap: Papyrus callbacks and all action/camera/sound lane interactions remain separate runtime acceptance.
Animated stations/transitions, props, commits, countermand, scene suspension and world replacement require the matrix in OVERLAY_ACCEPTANCE.md.
Broker tests cover the container and callbacks; real save/load/delete hooks, VM rebuild and world-replacement teardown remain unverified.

feature: Sound pools, subtitle parsing and WEM encoding
gap: Audible Wwise playback, mixing, spatialization, interruption and live subtitles need game acceptance.

feature: Player input and camera locks; fade; undo ledger
gap: Baseline scenes disable these mechanisms. Default and explicit engagement/restoration for every termination cause need dedicated game cases.
Parsing is covered; visible attachment, apparel restoration, weapon state and prop ownership are not proven.

feature: Matchmaking, role binding and world anchors
gap: Engine form filters, actor selection, priority/weight and furniture validation need representative actors and assets in game.

feature: Animation browser, library, wheel and bridge
gap: Browser verify runs Vitest, TypeScript and Vite. Real WebView2 rendering/input, wheel persistence and launchers need game/UI acceptance.

feature: Settings, hotkeys and durable health issues
gap: Distribution validates the schema payload; Settings SDK handoff, live hotkeys and issue lifecycle need game acceptance.
Studio pairing, mailbox expiry, unsaved AF preview and ownership cleanup need a Studio integration scenario.
Both archives are built and checked; clean install, upgrade, Papyrus freshness and restart acceptance are not established by packaging.
